data.rationale: The proposal matches the true workflow: destination typed into the "WHERE DO YOU WANT TO GO?" box, optional dates, optional Filters amenity (RV Site), then FIND A KOA. It renames the amenity parameter as stay_type, adds a suggestion-pick step, and gives only loose date-picker detail, so an automation is mostly buildable but needs some date-picker and suggestion handling.
